# When mapping fixed-world direction end force to joint torque via end-effector Jacobian, what ReferenceFrame should Pinocchio use?

> **Current answer:** After the author explicitly defined this objective, the maintainer clarified the use of LOCAL_WORLD_ALIGNED. The thread also clarified that the fixed universe/inertial frame is fixed, while the world-aligned coincident point can move with the target frame. Since the author did not publish torque results or re-measure, this conclusion is only a reference-frame selection entry; wrench arrangement, action point, sign, and Jacobian transposition still need to be verified in the target model.

## Problem and symptoms

- What Jacobian should the Pinocchio thread request to map fixed-world direction force to joint torque?
- The author mistakenly believed the WORLD frame moves with the robot, thus failing to determine which Jacobian to pair with fixed-world direction force.
